'''Revan's hideout''' was an abandoned apartment used as a hideout by [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and<ref name="KOTOR" /> his<ref name="Campaign">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> companions during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Following the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack]] on the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' above the Outer Rim planet of Taris, Revan, together with Republic soldier Carth Onasi, crashed onto the planet in an escape pod. The crash left Revan unconscious, but the following commotion was enough for Onasi to drag him away from the crash site unseen. Onasi dragged Revan to the abandoned apartment, located in the [[South Apartments]], an apartment complex ring located in the [[Upper City]] of the ecumenopolis. Revan later awoke from one of the apartment's beds a few days after the crash.<ref name="KOTOR" /> The local authorities of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and later the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] occupiers, turned a blind [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to the complex, as it was mostly inhabited by illegal [[Alien/Legends|non-humans]] forced to live there by the [[Speciesism|speciesist]] laws of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
